subject_rule: Open: Chevening names no subject list or subject restriction; its course page says scholars can choose any Chevening-eligible course at any UK university, and the only limits are on course type (full-time taught master's of nine to twelve months starting in autumn, plus one Oxford postgraduate diploma), not on subject.
notes: No programmes are recorded: Chevening publishes no list of courses, only a search tool (course finder) on its site, which is supplied by a third party and is a search page, not a document, so it was not used.

Wording of the source (course page): 'You can choose any Chevening-eligible course at any UK university.' The page does not use the words 'any subject'; any_subject is set because it states no subject limit anywhere and limits eligibility by course format only. Editors may prefer to keep it as 'any eligible course'.
The one named exception to the taught-master's rule is the postgraduate diploma in Diplomatic Studies at Oxford University.
not_stated: A list of eligible courses or subjects (only the course finder search exists)
